---

Anirudh Vasudevan is a 5x hackathon winner. He placed Top 10 at the Y Combinator AI Hackathon with LARK, won ElevenHacks (Stripe x ElevenLabs) with Living Photos, took 2nd Place at the ElevenLabs x Replit Hackathon with FaceTime from Mars, took 3rd Place at ElevenHacks (ElevenLabs x Zed) with Apartment 4B, and won Best Voice Agent at the ElevenLabs x Firecrawl Hackathon with ScreenSense. In ElevenHacks Season 1 he submitted a project to all 11 hacks and finished 4th overall.

I like building a whole product in a weekend and putting it in front of judges. Most of these builds use voice AI: an agent you talk to, a game you play out loud, or a browser you control by speaking. "Entry" means I built and entered the project and no placement is recorded for it.
